title: 109 Dandelion Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 109 Dandelion Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Perfectly positioned in the heart of WaterColor’s coveted Cottage District, 109 Dandelion Drive offers an elevated coastal retreat just steps from Seaside and directly across from the WaterColor Tennis Center. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection, this spacious home invites guests to experience the best of 30A with ease. With over 3,300 square feet of beautifully refreshed living space, this pet-friendly home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests. Enjoy the convenience of a 6-passenger electric cart, six adult bikes, and exclusive access to the WaterColor Beach Club, creating a seamless and memorable stay from arrival to departure. Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Outdoor Dining in Screened Porch Third-Floor Watchtower Office Outdoor Grill Enclosed Outdoor Shower Directly Across From the WaterColor Tennis Center 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club One Block From Seaside Path Experience the Home From the moment you arrive, the home welcomes you with a sense of ease that defines a true WaterColor stay. Natural light fills the main living spaces, where the open layout allows everyone to gather comfortably while still feeling relaxed and unhurried. Whether you are preparing breakfast before heading to the beach or winding down after a full day along 30A, the space feels both functional and inviting. The kitchen is designed to be part of the experience rather than separate from it, offering generous space for cooking, conversation, and connection. Mornings often begin here with coffee and quiet planning for the day, while evenings naturally shift into shared meals and time spent together. Just beyond the living area, the screened porch becomes a favorite gathering spot. It is the kind of space where dinners linger a little longer, where kids drift in and out after bike rides, and where the pace of the day slows down without effort. The outdoor areas create a natural extension of the home, making it easy to enjoy the coastal setting at any time of day. The layout provides a thoughtful balance between shared spaces and private retreats. The first-floor guest suite offers convenience and separation, while the second floor brings together the primary suite and additional bedrooms in a way that works especially well for families traveling together. The third-floor watchtower offers a quiet, tucked-away space that can be used for remote work, reading, or simply stepping away for a moment of calm. It adds a unique element to the home and gives guests a place to recharge when needed. Throughout the home, refreshed interiors and updated finishes create a clean, elevated coastal feel that reflects the relaxed yet refined nature of WaterColor living. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Hall Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Kitchen, Living Room, Laundry Room Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Jetted Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Third Floor: Home Office Life in WaterColor From early morning bike rides beneath shaded oak canopies to afternoons spent at the Beach Club and evenings exploring Seaside, this location places you at the center of it all. Tennis is just steps from your front door, while the beach, pools, and dining are all within an easy ride. With its refreshed interiors, generous layout, and one of the most convenient locations in WaterColor, 109 Dandelion Drive offers a stay that feels both elevated and effortlessly comfortable for families and groups alike.
